frontend-suite.description: Everything for frontend work in one install — semantic markup, accessibility, React/Next/TypeScript, Tailwind tokens + design system, design quality, SEO, Storybook, SVGs, cookie consent, branding/copy, structure, naming, and the repo's CI/CD.

frontend-audits-suite.description: The review mirror of the frontend suite — one manually-invoked audit per domain, each self-contained, each writing a scored and prioritised report. `audit-all` detects what applies, runs every applicable one, and aggregates them.

backend-suite.description: Everything for API and server work in one install — the route→service architecture, server-side security mapped to OWASP, field-level encryption, the OpenAPI registry, plus the shared structure, naming, TypeScript, monorepo, and CI standards the backend leans on.

backend-audits-suite.description: The review mirror of the backend suite — API architecture, authorization coverage, application security, environment and secrets, and documentation. `audit-all` detects what applies and aggregates them.

firebase-suite.description: The official Firebase agent-skills we use — auth, Firestore, security rules, hosting, App Hosting, Data Connect, AI Logic, Remote Config, and the rules auditor. Vendored from Google, unedited.

cloudinary-suite.description: The official Cloudinary agent-skills we use — the Next.js and React SDKs, transformation URLs, and docs lookup. Vendored from Cloudinary, unedited.

workflow-suite.description: The cross-project actions — staged Conventional Commits, a self-contained PR review, scaffolding an app, a monorepo, a feature, or an AGENTS.md, framework migrations, changelogs, and cross-app drift sync.
